scripts.deploy:site: npm run build --workspace=../website && aws s3 sync ../website/out/ s3://$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name JimixerComStack --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`BucketName`].OutputValue' --output text --profile ${AWS_ADMIN_PROFILE:-jimixer-admin}) --delete --profile ${AWS_ADMIN_PROFILE:-jimixer-admin}
